The main takeaway from our work is that
CTCs can provide information about the tumor that cannot be obtained from the primary tumor alone.

CTCs can be a useful source of genomic information for breast cancer patients, and that the genomic signatures identified in CTCs can potentially be used to identify patients with a higher risk of relapse or metastasis.
